data.name: Can't Escape It
data.detailed_description:
You're about to experience found footage of an unknown person — trapped in a looping apartment, hunted by a clown.

Who they are. Why they're there. Why the clown's hunting them. None of it is clear — not yet. You're about to see what happened to them :)

Puzzles are scattered through the apartment, and the only way through them is piecing together every clue you can find.

The apartment only gets darker from here. Night vision is the one thing that cuts through it, but every second it's on, it drains a battery you'll need to manage carefully.

One last thing: you can't fight back. Spot the clown, and it's run or hide — and hope he hasn't spotted you first. If he has, you don't want to know what happens next :)

Gameplay

No combat, no weapons. Your only real tools when he's close are staying quiet and knowing when to run.

DON'T GET CAUGHT.

There are no notes, no audio logs — nothing here is spelled out for you. The answer is always in your surroundings. Pay attention.

Visual Atmosphere

You'll be seeing photorealistic footage of an early-90s apartment, shot entirely through the camera you're carrying, in late-90s VHS style.

Night vision is the only way to see once the lights are gone, narrowing your whole world down to a grainy, high-contrast sliver of visibility — and reminding you the whole time that it's burning battery you'll need again.

data.short_description: Can't Escape It is a first-person, found-footage, psychological horror game. You are trapped in a looping apartment. Search for clues to solve puzzles and find a way out, evade a clown that chases you, navigate the dark using your night vision, and manage your batteries. CAN YOU ESCAPE IT?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 (3GB) or AMD Radeon RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 21 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-10700K or AMD Ryzen 7 5800X
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3070 Ti / RTX 4070 or AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT (8GB+ VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 21 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: It has violence related to alcoholism and Domestic abuse
